data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 15.069m. During 2015 there was a gross strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 1.013m (6.7% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development in liability-related accounts; the report specifically notes strengthening of Specialty Programmes and Package Programmes reserves in recognition of accelerated claim development. Overall the movement is small and explicitly shown in the claims movements note.
raw_causal_phrases: The liability reserves of the Speciality Programmes and Package Programmes accounts have been strengthened in recognition of accelerated claim development in the year.
On a whole account basis, the claims experience in 2015 has been better than expected based on the prior year reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) taken from note 'Movement arising from prior years' (gross column) = GBP 1,013k. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet prior-year comparative claims outstanding = GBP 15,069k. Gross premiums written: two totals appear in the report (managing agent class table totals GBP 43,178k, calendar year income statement shows GBP 43,859k); the class split used is from the managing agent's class table summing to GBP 43,178k. Some LOB-to-standard mappings (e.g. Specialty Programmes -> Professional Lines) are inferred and amounts by LOB movements are not explicitly quantified in the report. Claims development table is partial and presented in thousands.
